verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an incident.io mobile app, or acknowledging, escalating, and resolving alerts from a phone. The on-call docs cover alerts, escalation paths, and schedules, but not a mobile client. Slack/Teams-native response and Twilio call routing are host-platform or adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward a full mobile app.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am
